<!-- wp:html -->
<div class="uc">
<style>

@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');
.uc{--bg:#fff;--panel:#F5F3EC;--kh:#7A6D3C;--kh-t:#7E7038;--kh-l:#D2C48F;--dark:#0D1017;--tx:#262626;--tx2:#5E5D56;
 font-family:'Montserrat',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--tx);background:var(--bg);line-height:1.65;font-size:16px;
 width:100%;margin:0;overflow-x:clip;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
.uc *{box-sizing:border-box}
.uc img{max-width:100%;display:block}
.uc a{text-decoration:none}
.uc .w{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
.uc h1,.uc h2,.uc h3{font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;line-height:1.15;margin:0;color:var(--dark);font-weight:700}
.uc h2{font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,44px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.uc h2 em,.uc h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--kh-t)}
.uc .eyebrow{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;color:var(--kh-t);margin-bottom:12px;display:block}
.uc .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:var(--kh);color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;padding:8px 8px 8px 28px;border-radius:999px;transition:.2s}
.uc .btn i{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:var(--kh);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.uc .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(122,109,60,.35)}
.uc .btn svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.uc .btn.wide{background:#fff;color:var(--dark);width:100%;max-width:560px;justify-content:space-between;box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(13,16,23,.08)}
.uc .btn.wide i{background:var(--kh);color:#fff}
/* hero */
.uc .hero{background:var(--dark);color:#fff;border-radius:0 0 0 clamp(48px,9vw,120px);position:relative}
.uc .nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:26px 0}
.uc .logo{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#fff;font-size:15px}.uc .logo b{color:var(--kh-l)}
.uc .nav .tg{color:var(--kh-l);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;background:rgba(13,16,23,.65);padding:9px 18px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(210,196,143,.3);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.uc .hero{overflow:hidden}
.uc .hero-g{min-height:clamp(520px,64vh,700px);display:flex;align-items:center}
.uc .hero-t{padding:40px 0 84px;width:min(calc(100% - 520px),600px);position:relative;z-index:2}
.uc .hero h1{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(32px,4vw,52px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin-bottom:22px}
.uc .hero h1 em{color:var(--kh-l);display:block}
.uc .hero p{color:#C9C8C0;max-width:480px;margin:0 0 34px}
.uc .hero .btn{background:var(--kh-l);color:var(--dark)}
.uc .hero .btn i{background:var(--dark);color:var(--kh-l)}
.uc .facts{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:34px}
.uc .facts span{border:1px solid rgba(210,196,143,.35);color:var(--kh-l);font-size:13px;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:999px}
.uc .hero-p{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;right:max(0px,calc((100% - 1440px)/2));width:min(54%,720px);z-index:1}
.uc .hero-p img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 14%}
.uc .hero-p::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--dark) 0%,rgba(13,16,23,.1) 38%,rgba(13,16,23,.3) 100%),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(13,16,23,.5),transparent 35%)}
@media(min-width:1500px){.uc .hero-p img{-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 80%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 80%,transparent)}}
.uc .nav{position:relative;z-index:3}
@media(max-width:960px){
 .uc .hero-g{display:block;min-height:0}
 .uc .hero-p{position:relative;right:auto;width:auto;height:clamp(300px,64vw,420px);margin:0}
 .uc .hero-p::after{background:linear-gradient(0deg,var(--dark) 0%,rgba(13,16,23,.1) 55%)}
 .uc .hero-t{width:auto;padding:8px 0 56px;margin-top:-14px}
 .uc .nav{padding:18px 0}
 .uc .nav-w{position:relative;z-index:3}
}
@media(max-width:480px){.uc .hero .btn{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}.uc .facts{margin-top:24px}.uc .logo{font-size:13px}}
/* floating telegram CTA (mobile) */
.uc .fab{display:none}
@media(max-width:700px){
 .uc .fab{display:flex;position:fixed;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:14px;z-index:50;background:var(--kh);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 6px 6px 24px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(13,16,23,.35)}
 .uc .fab i{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:var(--kh);display:grid;place-items:center}
 .uc .fab svg{width:18px;height:18px}
}
/* about */
.uc section{padding:clamp(56px,8vw,104px) 0}
.uc .about-g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:clamp(30px,6vw,80px);align-items:center}
.uc .ph{position:relative;max-width:440px;margin:0 auto;width:100%}
.uc .ph::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-7%;bottom:-6%;width:88%;height:88%;background:var(--panel);border-radius:48% 52% 40px 60% / 50% 40% 60% 50%}
.uc .ph img{position:relative;border-radius:28px;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;width:100%;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(13,16,23,.18)}
.uc .about p{color:var(--tx2);margin:18px 0 0}
.uc .tl{margin:30px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none;border-left:2px solid var(--kh-l)}
.uc .tl li{padding:0 0 18px 24px;position:relative;font-size:15px;color:var(--tx2)}
.uc .tl li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-7px;top:6px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--kh)}
.uc .tl b{display:block;color:var(--dark);font-weight:600}
@media(max-width:900px){.uc .about-g{grid-template-columns:1fr}.uc .ph{max-width:380px}}
/* services */
.uc .panel{background:var(--panel);border-radius:40px;padding:clamp(28px,5vw,64px) clamp(18px,4vw,56px);margin:0 12px}
.uc .sv-g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin:36px 0 36px}
.uc .card{background:#fff;border-radius:28px;padding:28px}
.uc .card .ic{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--kh);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:18px}
.uc .card .ic svg{width:24px;height:24px}
.uc .card h3{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:8px}
.uc .card p{margin:0;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--tx2)}
.uc .center{display:flex;justify-content:center}
@media(max-width:900px){.uc .sv-g{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:600px){.uc .sv-g{grid-template-columns:1fr}.uc .btn.wide{font-size:14px}}
/* results (grid 4/2/1) */
.uc .res-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px;margin-top:34px}
.uc .res{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;background:var(--panel);border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden}
.uc .res-photo{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;padding:0;margin:0;border:0;background:#fff;cursor:zoom-in;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.uc .res-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 0;transition:transform .35s}
.uc .res-photo:hover img{transform:scale(1.03)}
.uc .res-photo::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:46px;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(245,243,236,.95),rgba(245,243,236,0))}
.uc .res-tx{padding:18px 20px 20px;flex:1}
.uc .res-tx h3{font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--dark)}
.uc .res-tx p{margin:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--tx2)}
.uc .res .bar{background:var(--dark);color:var(--kh-l);padding:14px 20px;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px}
.uc .res-cta{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-top:40px}
.uc .lead{color:var(--tx2);max-width:640px;margin:14px 0 0}
@media(max-width:1100px){.uc .res-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:620px){.uc .res-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px}.uc .res-photo{aspect-ratio:4/5}.uc .res-tx h3{font-size:18px}.uc .res-tx p{font-size:15px}}
.uc .lb{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;background:rgba(13,16,23,.9);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;overflow:auto}
.uc .lb[hidden]{display:none}
.uc .lb img{max-width:min(920px,100%);max-height:100%;width:auto;height:auto;border-radius:12px;background:#fff}
.uc .lb-x{position:fixed;top:14px;right:18px;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);color:#fff;font-size:28px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
/* reviews (masonry columns) */
.uc .rv-grid{column-count:3;column-gap:18px;margin-top:32px}
.uc .rv{break-inside:avoid;margin:0 0 18px;padding:24px 24px 20px;border:1px solid rgba(210,196,143,.22);border-radius:28px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.uc .rv-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.uc .rv-st{color:var(--kh-l);letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:17px}
.uc .rv-date{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#A9A89F}
.uc .rv blockquote{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.6;color:#ECEBE4}
.uc .rv figcaption{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;border-top:1px solid rgba(210,196,143,.2);padding-top:12px}
.uc .rv figcaption b{font-size:15.5px;color:#fff}
.uc .rv figcaption span{font-size:13px;color:#A9A89F}
.uc .demo-note{margin-top:20px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px dashed rgba(210,196,143,.5);border-radius:18px;font-size:13px;color:#C9C8C0;text-align:center}
@media(max-width:1000px){.uc .rv-grid{column-count:2}}
@media(max-width:640px){.uc .rv-grid{column-count:1}.uc .rv{padding:20px 18px 16px}}
/* reviews */
.uc .rev{background:var(--dark);border-radius:40px;margin:0 12px;padding:clamp(32px,6vw,72px) clamp(20px,5vw,64px);color:#fff}
.uc .rev h2{color:#fff}.uc .rev h2 em{color:var(--kh-l)}.uc .rev .eyebrow{color:var(--kh-l)}
.uc .rev-slot{margin-top:32px;border:1.5px dashed rgba(210,196,143,.4);border-radius:28px;padding:44px 24px;text-align:center;color:#B9B8B0;font-size:15px}
/* Тема плагіна відгуків (WP Personal Reviews, шорткод react_reviews) у стилі S2 Khaki Light. Лише оформлення, плагін не змінюється. */
.uc .rv-plugin{margin-top:40px;padding-top:36px;border-top:1px solid rgba(210,196,143,.22)}
.uc .rv-plugin-lead{margin:0 0 6px;color:#C9C8C0;font-size:15px;max-width:760px}
.uc .react-personal-reviews{color:#fff;font-family:'Montserrat',system-ui,sans-serif}
.uc .personal-reviews-container{display:flex;flex-direction:column;max-width:none;padding:0;margin:0}
.uc .personal-reviews-container>.review-form{order:2}
.uc .react-personal-reviews .loading{color:#A9A89F;padding:30px 0}
/* картки відгуків */
.uc .carousel-container{padding:18px 0 64px!important;margin-bottom:0!important}
.uc .carousel-slides>div{display:flex}
.uc .review-card,.uc .review-card.list-view{width:100%;background:var(--panel);color:var(--tx);border:0;border-radius:28px;padding:26px 24px;box-shadow:none;transform:none;transition:transform .2s}
.uc .review-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:none}
.uc .review-card h3{font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;line-height:1.25;margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--dark)}
.uc .review-card .rating{color:var(--kh);font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.12em;margin:0 0 12px}
.uc .review-card .review-text{color:var(--tx2);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 14px}
.uc .review-card .social-link{color:var(--kh-t);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(126,112,56,.4)}
.uc .review-card .review-date{color:var(--tx2);font-size:13px;margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #E2DED0}
.uc .reviews-list{gap:18px}
/* стрілки й крапки каруселі */
.uc .carousel-button-left,.uc .carousel-button-right{width:44px;height:44px;background:var(--kh-l)!important;border:0!important;color:var(--dark)!important;box-shadow:none}
.uc .carousel-button-left,.uc .carousel-button-right{top:auto!important;bottom:6px;transform:none!important}
.uc .carousel-button-left{left:0!important}.uc .carousel-button-right{right:0!important}
.uc .carousel-button-left svg,.uc .carousel-button-right svg{stroke:var(--dark)}
.uc .carousel-dots{bottom:21px!important;height:14px!important;width:100%!important;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;left:0;align-items:center}
.uc .carousel-dot{background:rgba(210,196,143,.38)!important;border:0!important}
.uc .carousel-dot[style*="255, 255, 255"]{background:var(--kh-l)!important}
/* форма «Залишити відгук» */
.uc .review-form{max-width:720px;width:100%;margin:8px auto 0;padding:34px 32px;background:var(--panel);color:var(--tx);border:0;border-radius:28px;box-shadow:none}
.uc .review-form h3{font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:24px;color:var(--dark);margin:0 0 22px}
.uc .form-group{margin-bottom:14px;position:relative}
.uc .form-group input,.uc .form-group textarea{width:100%;padding:15px 22px;border:1px solid #E2DED0;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:var(--tx);font:500 15px/1.4 'Montserrat',sans-serif;box-sizing:border-box}
.uc .form-group textarea{border-radius:24px;min-height:130px}
.uc .form-group>div{width:240px!important;max-width:100%}
.uc .form-group select{width:100%!important;padding:15px 44px 15px 22px!important;border:1px solid #E2DED0!important;border-radius:999px!important;background:#fff!important;color:var(--tx);font:500 15px/1.4 'Montserrat',sans-serif;box-sizing:border-box}
.uc .form-group input:focus,.uc .form-group textarea:focus,.uc .form-group select:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--kh);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(122,109,60,.18)}
.uc .reviews-submit-button,.uc .review-form button[type="submit"]{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:16px 34px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:var(--kh);color:#fff;font:600 15px/1 'Montserrat',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.uc .reviews-submit-button:hover,.uc .review-form button[type="submit"]:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(122,109,60,.35)}
.uc .reviews-submit-button:disabled{background:#A9A27E;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;box-shadow:none}
.uc .review-form .message{margin-top:14px;padding:14px 18px;border-radius:18px;font-size:14.5px}
.uc .review-form .message.success{background:#E7F0E2;color:#1F4A25;border:1px solid #BCD4B4}
.uc .review-form .message.error{background:#F8E3E3;color:#7A1E1E;border:1px solid #E5B7B7}
@media(max-width:860px){
 .uc .carousel-container{padding:12px 0 84px!important}
 .uc .carousel-button-left,.uc .carousel-button-right{bottom:16px;width:42px;height:42px}
 .uc .carousel-button-left{left:calc(50% - 54px)!important;right:auto!important}.uc .carousel-button-right{right:calc(50% - 54px)!important;left:auto!important}
 .uc .carousel-dots{display:none!important}
 .uc .review-form{padding:26px 18px}
}
/* contacts / footer */
.uc .page-end{background:var(--dark);color:#fff;margin-top:clamp(40px,6vw,80px);border-radius:clamp(40px,7vw,96px) clamp(40px,7vw,96px) 0 0;padding:clamp(44px,7vw,88px) 0 0}
.uc .page-end h2{color:#fff}.uc .page-end h2 em{color:var(--kh-l)}.uc .page-end .eyebrow{color:var(--kh-l)}
.uc .ct{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(24px,4vw,56px);align-items:stretch}
.uc .ct-l>p{color:#B9B8B0;margin:14px 0 22px;max-width:420px}
.uc .row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(210,196,143,.16);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 26px 8px 8px;margin-top:12px;color:#fff;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500;transition:.2s}
.uc a.row:hover{background:rgba(210,196,143,.14);border-color:rgba(210,196,143,.4)}
.uc .row i{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--kh-l);color:var(--dark);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.uc .row svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.uc .row small{display:block;color:#A9A89F;font-weight:400;font-size:12.5px}
.uc .map{border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;min-height:360px;background:#1a1e27;border:1px solid rgba(210,196,143,.2)}
.uc .map iframe{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:360px;border:0;display:block}
.uc .end-bar{margin-top:clamp(36px,5vw,64px);border-top:1px solid rgba(210,196,143,.18);padding:22px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px 24px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#A9A89F;font-size:13px}
.uc .end-bar a{color:var(--kh-l);font-weight:600}
@media(max-width:900px){.uc .ct{grid-template-columns:1fr}.uc .row{border-radius:32px;padding-right:18px}.uc .page-end{padding-bottom:84px}.uc .end-bar{padding-bottom:12px}}
.uc .menu-cb{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;width:0;height:0}
.uc .nav{gap:24px}
.uc .nav .menu{display:flex;gap:28px;margin:0 auto;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.uc .nav .menu a{color:#D9D7CC;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;transition:.15s}
.uc .nav .menu a:hover{color:var(--kh-l);border-color:var(--kh-l)}
.uc .burger{display:none;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);cursor:pointer;flex:none;position:relative}
.uc .burger i,.uc .burger i::before,.uc .burger i::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:11px;width:20px;height:2px;background:#fff;border-radius:2px;transition:.2s}
.uc .burger i{top:20px}.uc .burger i::before{left:0;top:-7px}.uc .burger i::after{left:0;top:7px}
.uc .menu-cb:checked ~ .burger i{background:transparent}
.uc .menu-cb:checked ~ .burger i::before{top:0;transform:rotate(45deg)}
.uc .menu-cb:checked ~ .burger i::after{top:0;transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.uc .fnav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 26px;margin:clamp(22px,3vw,34px) 0 0;padding:20px 0 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.uc .fnav a{color:var(--kh-l)}.uc .fnav a:hover{color:#fff}
@media(max-width:900px){.uc .nav{gap:8px}.uc .nav .menu{display:none}.uc .nav .tg{margin-left:auto}.uc .burger{display:block}.uc .menu-cb:checked ~ .menu{display:flex;position:absolute;top:calc(100% - 4px);left:0;right:0;z-index:30;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin:0;padding:10px;background:#141821;border:1px solid rgba(210,196,143,.3);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}.uc .menu-cb:checked ~ .menu a{display:block;padding:15px 16px;border-radius:14px;font-size:16px;color:#fff;border:0}.uc .menu-cb:checked ~ .menu a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:var(--kh-l)}.uc .fnav{flex-direction:column;gap:2px}.uc .fnav a{display:block;padding:11px 0}}
@media(max-width:430px){.uc .nav .tg{display:none}.uc .burger{margin-left:auto}}

.uc .hero.sub{padding-bottom:0}
.uc .hero.sub .hero-g{min-height:0;display:block}
.uc .hero.sub .hero-t{width:auto;max-width:760px;padding:30px 0 clamp(70px,9vw,110px)}
.uc .crumbs{font-size:13px;color:#A9A89F;margin-bottom:18px}
.uc .crumbs a{color:var(--kh-l)}
.uc .hero.sub h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5.4vw,64px)}
.uc .hero.sub h1 em{display:inline}
/* Борисов (S2 Khaki Light): сторінки «Контакти», «Політика», футер з email і Політикою, блок соцмереж */
.uc .cc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.uc .cc{display:block;background:#fff;border-radius:28px;padding:26px 26px 28px;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.uc a.cc:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(13,16,23,.1)}
.uc .cc small{display:block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;color:var(--kh-t);margin-bottom:8px}
